subject: general
question: Which of the following is the world's second-largest language family?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sino-Tibetan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is the w**orld's second-largest language**__ family, with more than one billion speakers of its hundreds of different languages.
 
• It consists of **453 daughter languages **and has around **1.268 billion speakers throughout Asia. **
 
• It **includes both the Sinitic languages **(known as the Chinese dialects) and the **Tibeto-Burman languages (such as Tibetan and Burmese). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The third largest language family in the world and the largest in **Africa is the Niger-Congo.** It consists of 1,524 daughter languages and has around** 437 million speakers throughout Africa.**
 
• The Indo-European languages are **a language family native to the overwhelming majority of Europe, the Iranian plateau, and the northern Indian subcontinent**.
 
• The Austronesian peoples, sometimes referred to as Austronesian-speaking peoples, are **a large group of peoples in Taiwan, Maritime Southeast Asia, Micronesia, coastal New Guinea, Island Melanesia, Polynesia, and Madagascar that speak Austronesian languages**.
